fragments.text: Thou rememberest the work of the world and Thou art aware of all creatures of antiquity. Before Thee all secrets are revealed and the multitude of hidden things from the beginning of time. There is no forgetfulness before Thy glorious throne and there is nought concealed before Thine eyes. Thou rememberest every deed and not even one creature is hidden from Thee. Everything is exposed and known before Thee, O Lord our God, watching and looking to the end of all generations. For Thou dost bring a fixed time for remembrance, when every spirit and soul will be considered and many deeds and an infinite mass of creatures will be remembered. From the beginning hast Thou made this known and long ago revealed it. This is the day of the beginning of Thy works, a memorial of the first day, for it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the God of Jacob. And regarding territories, it is decided on it which shall be for the sword and which for peace, which for famine and which for plenty. And the creatures will be considered on it to be mentioned either for life or death. Who is not considered on this day? Indeed the memory of every created thing comes before Thee, man’s work and his task, the actions of man’s footsteps, man’s thought and his devices, and the motives of man’s deeds. Fortunate the man who does not forget Thee and the son of man who clings to Thee, for those that seek Thee will never stumble nor will those that take refuge with Thee ever be disgraced. For the remembrance of all actions comes before Thee and Thou dost examine all of them.

Noah also didst Thou remember in love and consider for the sake of salvation and compassion when Thou didst bring the waters of the flood to destroy all flesh because of the wickedness of their actions. Therefore his memory came before Thee, O Lord our God, to increase his descendants like the dust of the earth and his offspring like the sand of the sea.
